description: On the single virtual output, one visible dock surface contains the four pinned launchers.

assertions.comment: This is an invariant in the single-output container: I see one dock window on its only primary output. A second virtual output would be required to make primary-only placement causal.
This is an invariant in the single-output container: I see only the four launchers from its one dock. A second virtual output would be required to test whether another dock is incorrectly created.
